info.author: Maximilian Beiersdorfer, DJMaxergy; openDJ
info.description: openDJ's mapping for the Pioneer DDJ-SP1: Mixxx's DDJ-SX mapping moved to the DDJ-SP1's messages from Pioneer's MIDI message list and rekordbox's mapping file.
